name: Grand Hyatt Scottsdale Resort
insider_take: Desert luxury meets championship golf in the heart of Scottsdale's most prestigious resort corridor.
whats_special: This sprawling 493-acre resort sits on the original Gainey Ranch, featuring 27 holes of championship golf designed by the legendary trio of Palmer, Weiskopf, and Morrish. The property boasts a 2.5-acre water playground with sand beaches, waterslides, and a 40-person spa pool, plus the award-winning Spa Avania with authentic Native American-inspired treatments.
pro_tip: Book tee times at dawn to experience the desert course when wildlife is most active – you'll often spot roadrunners, javelinas, and desert foxes along the fairways.
dont_miss: The Thursday night Pinata Party at the pool (seasonal), sunset horseback rides through the adjacent McDowell Sonoran Preserve, and dinner at SWB (SouthWest Bistro) featuring locally-sourced Sonoran Desert cuisine with ingredients like prickly pear and mesquite honey.
pros: Stunning desert mountain views and desert landscape setting
World-class spa and multiple championship golf courses on-site
Multiple pools including lazy river and waterslide complex
Exclusive Hyatt Privé benefits including room upgrades and resort credits
cons: Resort fees and premium pricing for amenities
Large resort property requiring walking or shuttle transportation
